name: AINN-CoPilot
description: GenAI-powered 5G network management assistant using OPEA microservices, Simu5G digital twin simulation and a 3GPP/O-RAN RAG knowledge base.

paragraphs: ./deploy.sh now selects the live simulation stack. Open the Streamlit UI and ask for a baseline simulation to see job progress, measured KPIs and charts, cited diagnosis, and downloadable run artifacts. Pure standards questions use RAG without starting a simulation. See the live workflow and traffic burst, resource comparison, and mobility scenarios.

./deploy.sh --opea selects the real OPEA agent for evidence-grounded reasoning with OpenAI, while retaining the existing simulation job workflow. It requires private model credentials and makes paid inference requests during verification. See OPEA configuration and verification.

Telecom operations teams face high cognitive load: correlating live/replayed KPIs with 3GPP/O-RAN standards, internal runbooks, and prior incidents is slow and error-prone. TelcoMind reduces mean-time-to-understanding by turning an operator intent (for example "diagnose degraded handover on this cell") into a grounded diagnosis that cites the exact knowledge sources and the simulation evidence it used, while being explicit about what it did and did not do.
